comment: Manifest for one atomic knowledge release. Pins every pack by sha256+size so the packs cannot be altered without changing the manifest, and the manifest is what the release workflow attests (Sigstore build provenance). 'version' is monotonic; a client rejects any manifest whose version is <= the highest version it has already trusted (anti-rollback). 'prev_digest' chains to the previous manifest. In the in-package bootstrap snapshot there is no attestation: it is trusted because it rode in on the SSH-signed skill release.
